clue.text: A reminder that George is inside, naked

clue.text: Play short in front of area

a tar is an old word for a sailor, and two of them are needed here

clue.text: Financial stake in pursuit

a hobby or pastime one follows

clue.text: Waterproof paint?

clue.text: The practice of patronage
